name: Gulandross Vasgan
original_name: ギュランドロス・ヴァスガン
source: Gulandross became the ruler of Yun Gasol Union several years ago. From that time he began to attack Malucia way more than ever before, believing it will give him victory. Since there is also a the same possibility of defeat, Gulandross is referred to as "Foolish King". But due to his die-hard hedonism and strong belief, that country's development is king's duty, he continues to encourage people and they believe in flashy victory with enthusiasm.
